# Facebook Pages Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/facebook-pages-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-pages-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.524**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract basic data from multiple Facebook Pages or Profiles. Extract Facebook page details, website, email, address, messenger, likes, followers, rating, ad running status, and other public data. Export scraped data, schedule scraper via API, integrate with other tools or AI workflows.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Page $0.012, Page (Standby API) $0.012 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-pages-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-facebook-pages-scraper@0.0.524#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | array | yes | `[]` | Start urls — Provide urls of Facebook pages you want to get information from. Only works on facebook pages, not personal profiles (not even public ones). |

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |

| `followers` | number \| null | Number of followers of the page. |

| `phone` | string \| null | Contact phone number of the page. |
| `address` | string \| null | Physical address of the business. |
| `website` | string \| array \| null | Website URL linked on the page. |
| `websites` | array \| null | All website URLs linked on the page. |
| `messenger` | string \| null | Messenger URL for the page. |
| `intro` | string \| null | Short introductory text from the page profile. |
| `priceRange` | string \| null | Price range indicator for the business. |
| `services` | string \| null | Services offered by the business. |
| `alternativeSocialMedia` | string \| null | Links to other social media accounts. |
| `wifi` | string \| null | Wi-Fi availability information. |
| `payment` | object \| null | Accepted payment methods. |
| `posts` | array \| null | Recent posts from the page. |
| `personalProfile` | object \| null | Personal profile data (when the URL is a personal profile, not a page). |
| `autoGeneratedPage` | object \| null | Data for auto-generated Facebook pages. |
